name: DeepTags 0.8.0
body:
- Complete rewrite of DeepTags
- Faster loading of documents
- fixed the absence of colors on the tags (#2 )
- ability to pin and change the color of sub tags

name: DeepTags 0.7
body:
- DeepTags is **much faster** than it used to be
- heavy optimizations
- ability to copy tags to the clipboard 
- added an Ubuntu 20.04 (focal) build
- simplified the code by adding .ui files instead of manually allocating memory for every widget
- Added a Settings Dialog that contains 2 tabs, one for setting the Data Directory and another for setting external markdown editors
- fixed the wrong color in tabs from the light style of [QBreeze](https://github.com/SZinedine/QBreeze)
- fixed non removing empty tags
- The integrated reader: use MarkdownHighlighter from [qmarkdowntextedit](https://github.com/pbek/qmarkdowntextedit/) instead of the whole QMarkdownTextEdit class.

name: DeepTags 0.6
DeepTags 0.5.3
body:
* fixed failed to open documents when the filename contains invalid characters
* added a "close" action to the context menu of the integrated reader

name: DeepTags 0.5.2
body:
- A new dialog to set the data directory
- Enhanced [QBreeze](https://github.com/SZinedine/QBreeze) and updated it
- Multiple minor changes

name: DeepTags 0.5.1
body:
- Fixed unicode issues on windows
- integrated readere is activated by default
- supporting older systems

name: DeepTags 0.5
body:
* Added an integrated reader (activate the feature in:  `Edit -> Activate Integrated Reader`)
* Pin a tag item and change its color
* Added the Breeze (dark and light) style
* Systray icon (on linux)
* Added packaging scripts for AppImage, deb, and archlinux
